scenarios.name: account_get
scenarios.about: The account, decoded leniently: a field the API adds later (here `plan`) is ignored, never an error.

scenarios.name: unknown_verdict_kept
scenarios.about: A verdict the client does not know (one the API may add later) is kept as it is, never an error.

scenarios.name: access_token_as_bearer
scenarios.about: A personal access token is sent as a bearer credential, exactly as an API key is, with no check of its prefix.

scenarios.name: verify_answered
scenarios.about: A check answered within the API's 5-second hold: one POST with a new Idempotency-Key, the result and its job id.

scenarios.name: verify_force_recheck
scenarios.about: force_recheck is sent as `"force_recheck": true` beside the address.

scenarios.name: verify_polls_after_202
scenarios.about: A check not answered within 5 seconds is polled every 2 seconds until it is done.

scenarios.name: verify_no_wait_returns_pending
scenarios.about: With wait off, a 202 is returned as the pending check (its job id), and nothing is polled.

scenarios.name: verify_timeout_keeps_job_id
scenarios.about: A check that outlives its timeout raises a wait timeout that names the job, so the check can be resumed.

scenarios.name: verify_poll_error_keeps_job_id
scenarios.about: A poll that keeps failing raises the server error, which names the job already made.

error.message: internal error
internal error
internal error

scenarios.name: checks_wait_resumes
scenarios.about: A check is resumed by its job id, asking at once (it may be done already): its result, with that job id.

scenarios.name: verify_many_ten_singles
scenarios.about: Up to 10 addresses are checked one by one, in flight together, each with its own new key; results in input order.

scenarios.name: verify_many_eleven_is_one_list
scenarios.about: 11 addresses or more are one list: created, waited for, and its results mapped back to the input by row.

scenarios.name: verify_many_single_retried_same_key
scenarios.about: One of 10 checks loses its answer: it alone is sent again, with its own key, and gets the replay; one result each.

scenarios.name: verify_many_timeout_keeps_list_id
scenarios.about: A list that outlives the timeout of verify_many raises a wait timeout naming the list, so it can be resumed.

scenarios.name: list_create_from_emails
scenarios.about: A list from addresses is one JSON POST with a new key.

scenarios.name: list_create_from_csv
scenarios.about: A list from CSV text is a multipart upload: the email_column field first, then the file part, named and typed text/csv.

scenarios.name: upload_retried_with_same_key
scenarios.about: An upload whose answer is lost is sent again whole with the same key, and gets the replay: one list, charged once.

scenarios.name: retry_after_dropped_answer_same_key
scenarios.about: A check whose answer is lost is sent again with the same key, and gets the replay: one job, charged once.

scenarios.name: retry_after_503_same_key
scenarios.about: A 503 is retried after its Retry-After, with the same key.

error.message: the service is busy; retry shortly

scenarios.name: in_progress_retried_same_key
scenarios.about: A 409 idempotency_in_progress is retried after its Retry-After, with the same key, and gets the first request's answer.

error.message: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress; retry shortly

scenarios.name: idempotency_conflict_not_retried
scenarios.about: A 409 idempotency_conflict is a conflict error at once: never retried.

error.message: this Idempotency-Key was used with another request

scenarios.name: own_idempotency_key_sent
scenarios.about: A caller's own Idempotency-Key is sent as given.

scenarios.name: webhook_create_not_resent_after_drop
scenarios.about: A webhook's answer holds its secret, shown once, and the API does not replay it: a POST that may have arrived is not sent again.

scenarios.name: delete_retried_404_is_done
scenarios.about: A DELETE whose answer is lost is sent again; a 404 then means the first one did it, so the call succeeds.

error.message: webhook not found

scenarios.name: rate_limit_honours_retry_after
scenarios.about: A 429 is retried after its Retry-After, with the same key.

error.message: too many requests; the limit is 10 per second

scenarios.name: retry_after_too_long_raises
scenarios.about: A Retry-After longer than 60 seconds is not waited out: the rate-limit error is raised at once, with retry_after.

error.message: too many requests; the limit is 10 per second

scenarios.name: retries_exhausted_keep_last_request_id
scenarios.about: After the last retry, the error is the last answer's, with its request id; without Retry-After the waits back off.

error.message: internal error
internal error
internal error

scenarios.name: non_json_error_is_typed
scenarios.about: An error page that is not JSON (a proxy's) is still a typed error: its status, no code, its request id.

scenarios.name: auth_error_not_retried
scenarios.about: A refused key is an authentication error at once, never retried, and its message names the request id.

error.message: missing, malformed or revoked API key

scenarios.name: insufficient_credits
scenarios.about: A 402 is an insufficient-credits error at once, never retried.

error.message: the account has no credits

scenarios.name: forbidden
scenarios.about: A 403 (here a member's personal access token on a route only an admin may use) is a permission error.

error.message: only an organisation admin can do this

scenarios.name: not_found_escaped_id
scenarios.about: A path segment is percent-escaped (`/` and `?` included), so an id never changes the path; a 404 is a not-found error.

error.message: job not found

scenarios.name: gone
scenarios.about: A 410 is a not-found error with code gone, and a failed download leaves the file it was to replace as it was.

error.message: the upload and results of this job have been deleted

scenarios.name: consumer_list
scenarios.about: A 422 is an invalid-request error, with the API's code.

error.message: more than 40% of the addresses are on consumer email providers

scenarios.name: list_wait_backs_off
scenarios.about: Waiting for a list asks at once, then after 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds (then every 30), until it is done.

scenarios.name: results_follow_cursor_through_empty_pages
scenarios.about: Results follow next_cursor until it is null, through a page with no rows: every row once, in order.

scenarios.name: results_page_retried_same_cursor
scenarios.about: A page that fails is asked for again with the same cursor: no row skipped, none twice.

error.message: the service is busy; retry shortly

scenarios.name: results_same_cursor_twice_stops
scenarios.about: A page with no rows whose next_cursor is the cursor just sent would loop for ever: it is an error instead.

scenarios.name: results_not_ready_not_retried
scenarios.about: A 409 not_ready is a conflict error at once, never retried.

error.message: the job has not finished

scenarios.name: results_filters
scenarios.about: verdicts are sent comma-separated and partial as 1, beside the page size.

scenarios.name: download_writes_file
scenarios.about: A download asks for text/csv with its filter, and replaces the file with the whole CSV.

scenarios.name: download_cut_keeps_old_file
scenarios.about: A download cut short is retried from the start; when every try is cut, the error is a connection error and the old file is left as it was.

scenarios.name: lists_get
scenarios.about: A list's status and counts.

scenarios.name: lists_resolve
scenarios.about: Resolving every eligible row of a list sends no body, with a new key.

scenarios.name: lists_resolve_some
scenarios.about: Resolving some rows sends their addresses, with a new key.

scenarios.name: domains_get
scenarios.about: What is known about a domain.

scenarios.name: suppressions_list
scenarios.about: The suppression list: its domains and how many addresses.

scenarios.name: suppressions_add
scenarios.about: Adding to the suppression list sends addresses and domains, with a new key; the call returns how many were added.

scenarios.name: suppressions_remove
scenarios.about: Removing from the suppression list sends only what was given (no empty domains), and returns how many were removed.

scenarios.name: webhooks_create
scenarios.about: Registering a webhook returns it with its signing secret, shown only this once.

scenarios.name: webhooks_list
scenarios.about: The webhooks, oldest first, never their secrets.

scenarios.name: notices_list
scenarios.about: A page of contradiction notices after a position, with a limit; next_after is the next call's after.

notices.message: We reported ann@example.com as valid (safe to send) on 2026-10-01. A hard bounce on 2026-11-03 contradicts that, and re-verification now gives invalid. Remove it from your sends.

scenarios.name: feedback_report
scenarios.about: Reporting outcomes sends the events as given, with a new key.

scenarios.name: integrations_create
scenarios.about: Making an integration returns its webhook URL, shown only this once.

scenarios.name: integrations_list
scenarios.about: The integrations, oldest first, never their URLs.

scenarios.name: integrations_delete
scenarios.about: Deleting an integration: a 204 with no body.
